note: Built only from the official trophy descriptions (Exophase, PSNProfiles). Where a description does not pin down a count or a place, this page says so instead of inventing one. None of these trophies is missable: everything listed here stays available in free roam after the story.

sections.intro: Five trophies count things you find across Leonida. None of them is missable: every collectible stays available in free roam after the story.

items.counts: 3 sets · trophy: Don't Touch My Deck (Silver)
items.tip: Cards hide around Leonida. Sweep one region at a time and check the collection menu to see which sets are close - a set counts only when every card in it is found.
items.title: Collectible Cards - 3 full sets

items.tip: A pure exploration count. Pair it with the full-map sweep and the vehicle count: one long road trip across the state moves all three at once.
items.title: WAiNK It - 100 locations

items.counts: Every spot in Leonida · trophy: Positive Mental Attitude (Bronze)
items.tip: The official description gives no count, so use the in-game map markers and tick each spot off as you meditate there. The far corners are the spots players miss.
items.title: Meditation spots - every spot

items.tip: Drive or ride each one and the game logs it. Try every car, bike, boat and truck you pass rather than sticking to one favourite.
items.title: Vehicles - discover 100

items.counts: The whole state · trophy: The Goodtime State (Bronze)
items.tip: Drive every road and visit every region. The in-game map shows what is still blank - sweep the far edges last, with a fast car.
items.title: Explore all of Leonida

sections.title: Collectibles - what to find, and how much

sections.intro: The activity trophies are counts and one-offs from the game's side content. Try one of each type early - that alone earns Master of None.

items.tip: The hardest activity trophy. Work the challenge list one weapon at a time and replay any silver until it turns gold.
items.title: Shooting Range - 42 gold medals

items.counts: 20 wins · trophy: Earn Cash, Not Kudos (Bronze)
items.tip: Twenty distinct race events, not the same race twenty times. Work through the race list across Leonida.
items.title: Races - win 20 different events

items.tip: Learn each course on a practice run, then race to win. The description does not list how many locations there are - check the in-game race menu.
items.title: Top Fun Drone Races - a win at every location

items.tip: Jumps, near-misses and airtime, as the game counts them. Take them as you drive through the whole playthrough, not as an endgame grind.
items.title: Stunts - 250

items.tip: Driving, shooting, exploration and more. Pick the easy ones first; fifty is a fraction of the full list.
items.title: Challenges - 50 of any kind

items.counts: One try each · trophies: Baited My Tackle, Stick Fiddler, Let's Go Bowling, Fair Game
items.tip: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge; complete one arcade game; bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley; hunt Bret's unique animal. Each is a single outing.
items.title: Fishing, arcade, bowling, hunting

sections.title: Activities - the counted challenges

sections.intro: Four trophies run on in-game cash. All of them are cumulative, and none is missable - money keeps flowing in free roam.

items.tip: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists. Hand them to your contacts to clean them; small jobs add up.
items.title: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills

items.tip: Weapons, clothes, cars - anything the shops sell. Buy what you actually use; a big purchase closes the gap at the endgame.
items.title: Spend $100,000 across all shops

items.tip: Save up and buy garages as they appear on the property market. Keep a cash reserve - the last one is usually the priciest.
items.title: Buy all garage properties

items.tip: Open the Scooter Bros app and register ten different vehicles - the ones you drive anyway. Use the app, not a garage.
items.title: Register 10 vehicles - Scooter Bros

items.counts: 5 vaults, 1 truck · trophies: Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play
items.tip: Five bank vaults robbed and escaped, plus one armored truck. Plan the getaway before the robbery, with a fast car parked close by.
items.title: Robberies that pay - vaults & trucks

sections.title: Money - launder it, spend it, park it
